caption_text: August 1942. A Navy blimp named the L-8 took off from California with two crewmen aboard, patrolling for enemy submarines. An hour later, fishermen watched it drift silently overhead, engines running, radio silent. It later landed itself on a street near Daly City, doors still latched from the inside. Both parachutes were untouched. Both life vests were still on board. Neither crewman was ever found, alive or dead, and the Navy's official investigation closed without an answer.
